text: Senate File 166 - Introduced SENATE FILE 166 BY COMMITTEE ON STATE GOVERNMENT (SUCCESSOR TO SSB 1034) A BILL FOR An Act relating to bank utilization of filing services offered 1 by the secretary of state. 2 BE IT ENACTED BY THE GENERAL ASSEMBLY OF THE STATE OF IOWA: 3 TLSB 1415SV (1) 91 nls/ko S.F. 166 Section 1. Section 9.11, subsection 1, Code 2025, is amended 1 by adding the following new paragraph: 2 NEW PARAGRAPH . j. Chapter 524, including as provided in 3 section 524.303. 4 Sec. 2. NEW SECTION . 524.2002 Secretary of state —— extra 5 services —— surcharge. 6 Upon the request of a filer of a document under this chapter, 7 the secretary of state shall provide an extra filing service 8 and assess a surcharge as provided in chapter 9, subchapter II. 9 EXPLANATION 10 The inclusion of this explanation does not constitute agreement with 11 the explanation’s substance by the members of the general assembly. 12 This bill relates to services provided by the secretary of 13 state to filers of documents pursuant to Code chapter 524. The 14 bill permits banks to use preclearance and expedited filing 15 services offered by the secretary of state’s office. 16 -1- LSB 1415SV (1) 91 nls/ko 1/ 1
